description: A time-ordered feed of recent workspace changes — who created, edited, or trashed which documents, and when. Surfaces both in-app human edits and agent/API writes. Use it to catch up on what changed since you last looked (pass `since`), or to scope to one folder.

folderId.description: Limit to changes in documents within this folder.

since.description: Only return changes after this ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. "2026-07-01T00:00:00Z").

name: syncpen_recent_changes
